title: 一條送餐的路，成了機械遺產

data.prompt: Wide shot in a neutral archival display room, one curator uncovering a generic conveyor section while a separate small metal plate sits in a closed tray, no plaque or label, quiet overhead light.

lines.text: 二〇二一年，日本機械學會把「迴轉壽司輸送機」列為第一百一十二號機械遺產。

data.prompt: Medium shot in a modern unbranded sushi shop, one older attendant gently wiping a well-used serving-belt rim before customers arrive, focused expression, soft morning light.

lines.text: 它列出的，是元祿壽司堺東店當時仍在使用、一九八五年製造的輸送機；

data.prompt: Close-up in a neutral museum storeroom, one generic curator holding a separate early fan-shaped metal plate beside a later conveyor component without joining them, soft archival light.

lines.text: 還有元祿產業另外保存的早期「ウロコ」板片。一台是後來仍在運轉的機器，

data.prompt: Close-up on a simple demonstration workbench, one fan-shaped metal sample representing an early turn plate lying apart from a small simplified model of a later conveyor, open tabletop between the two plain objects, soft overhead light.

lines.text: 一組是早年解轉角的板片；分開看，才能看清這條送餐路在不同年代留下的東西。

data.prompt: Wide shot in an archival storeroom, one visitor looking between two separated plain storage cases, one with an early fan-shaped metal piece and another with a later conveyor component, soft neutral light.

lines.text: 早期那些扇形板，說明當年的轉角怎麼被解開。一台後來仍在運轉的機器，

data.prompt: Medium shot in a contemporary Japanese sushi dining room, one generic diner watching a plain dish arrive by a straight lane from a rear kitchen, soft ceiling light and an unmarked counter.

lines.text: 讓人看見這種送盤方式並沒有只停在發明的那一年。再看後場直線、旁通與ㄇ字型路線，

data.prompt: Wide street-level shot of a present-day unbranded Japanese sushi restaurant, one passerby looking through the window at a conveyor and a diner taking one plate inside, soft overcast daylight.

lines.text: 會發現每個店面回答的，其實還是同一個問題：壽司做好以後，怎麼走到客人面前？

data.prompt: Wide overhead shot of one present-day unbranded Japanese sushi counter, one diner reaching toward a plate that has just rounded a visible corner, open seats and the continuing belt leading toward a plain exit, gentle ceiling light.

lines.text: 那盤壽司先學會轉彎，後來也能從後場直走；

data.title: 盤子終於走到客人面前

lines.text: 改變的是路線，留下的是客人伸手取盤的那一刻。
你吃迴轉壽司時，會先拿眼前那盤，還是等最想吃的一盤走到面前？
如果你喜歡聽熟悉事物怎麼一步步變成今天的樣子，歡迎訂閱。
